sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 257 x 341 x 580 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

d&b architectural specification of the Y10P read 2026-11-12 (text file): "The dimensions (WxHxD) shall not exceed 257 x 580 x 341 mm", 18 kg, "connection panel on the back shall be recessed and fitted with speakon NLT4 F/M sockets (NL4 M or EP5 connectors as an option)", marine plywood with a PCP coating, two 8 in LF drivers and one 1.4 in compression driver on a rotatable CD horn, one handle on the top and one on the bottom panel, two M10 inserts top and bottom. The size is the plan size: the page and this spec label the axes the same way (H 580, W 257, D 341), so width 257 and height 580 are NOT swapped: the plan row needs no change. Not modelled: the top and bottom handles (the shape cuts side handles only), the M10 rigging inserts. The page lists "Two NLT4 F/M connectors" as standard: both are parallel inputs (bidir), the NL4 option pair is not modelled. Positions on the rear panel are guesses.

d&b product page read 2026-11-12: 580 x 257 x 341 mm under the label "Dimensions (h x w x d)", 18 kg. The corner radius (8 mm) and the driver layout of the baffle picture are our own estimate (no photo or drawing opened). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): drivers, a horn and sockets, no photo, no logo, no lettering.
